This is the bridge role between IT and the business. The person in this role makes sure every system we pay for is used correctly, by the right people, at the right depth, and drives the practical rollout of AI and agentic AI across our internal systems and processes. It is a hands-on role that combines three disciplines: system administration, business application ownership, and AI implementation and governance, Reports to the Head of IT. Ensure that we fully utilize existing systems by activating unused features, optimizing configurations, and automating manual processes. Permission model (role-based access, JML, SSO/SCIM, access reviews) Self-service request and approval workflows SaaS inventory, overlap mapping, consolidation and decommissioning Evaluate and approve new tools across technical fit, security/compliance, and commercial value. Manage vendors, renewals, and licenses. Partner with departments to translate business needs into system configurations, automations, and integrations. AI implementation and agentic AI governance Requirements 5+ years in business applications, SaaS operations, including hands-on ownership of at least three business platforms end to end - configuration, integrations and permissions, not first-line support. Strong Microsoft 365 administration with real depth in SharePoint Online - site architecture, permissions, document management and lifecycle. Proven experience designing and enforcing access and permission models, including SSO and SCIM or directory-based provisioning. Practical experience implementing AI tools and AI-driven automation in a business environment, with a track record of streamlining real processes and showing the time or quality gain. Experience working directly with business departments and translating their needs into system solutions. Project management skills: able to run a multi-stakeholder implementation or migration from scoping through rollout and adoption, managing timelines, dependencies, vendor coordination and stakeholder communication. Formal certification is not required. Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Hebrew. NICE TO HAVE Experience with SaaS management platforms such as Torii or Zluri. Hands-on experience with enterprise LLM platforms and agentic AI - Claude Enterprise, MCPs, connectors or agent frameworks. Experience leading a system consolidation or migration project.

Excellentes compétences en matière de communication, de relations interpersonnelles, de présentation et de technique. Excellentes compétences en matière de gestion du temps et de tâches multiples, et capacité à hiérarchiser les tâches avec un minimum de supervision. Esprit critique, forte capacité de résolution de problèmes et d’analyse. À titre de membre de l'équipe de MDA, vous et vos personnes à charge admissibles pouvez bénéficier d'un régime d'avantages sociaux qui assure un niveau de protection complet grâce à des soins de santé concurrentiels, y compris des régimes d'assurance-maladie complémentaire et de médicaments flexibles, des prestations dentaires et de vision, une protection du revenu en cas d'invalidité, une assurance-vie, des régimes d'épargne-retraite collectifs et un programme d'aide aux employés et aux familles.
